info.name: FMS · General Ledger API v1 (Power BI)
info.description:
Read-only General Ledger API for Power BI and other BI tools.

## Setup
1. Import an environment from `docs/api/general-ledger/postman/` (Local or Production).
2. Paste the API key into the environment variable **api_key** (type *secret*, **Current value** only — never Initial value, so it is not synced or exported).
3. Select the environment and run **00 · Connectivity → Meta**.

## Security
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer {{api_key}}` set once at collection level; requests inherit it.
- The collection contains no secrets. A pre-request guard blocks requests when the key is missing or when a non-local baseUrl is not HTTPS.
- Keys are issued and revoked on the server: `php artisan api-client:create|list|revoke`.

## Conventions
- Envelope: `{ data, meta, links }`; errors: `{ error: { status, code, message, details?, request_id } }`.
- Lists use cursor pagination: follow `links.next` until it is `null`.
- Default `status=posted` (Approved vouchers), same basis as the FMS trial balance.
- Amounts are numbers with 2 decimals; balances are debit-positive (`debit - credit`).

Full reference: `docs/api/general-ledger/README.md`.

exec: // Guard rails: refuse to send requests that would leak the key or hit the wrong place.
if (!base) { throw new Error('No baseUrl: select the "FMS GL API - Local" or "FMS GL API - Production" environment.'); }
if (!base.startsWith('https://') && !isLocal) { throw new Error('baseUrl must use HTTPS outside localhost.'); }
if (!noAuth && !pm.variables.get('api_key')) { throw new Error('Set api_key (type: secret, Current value) in the active environment. Never store it in the collection.'); }

item.name: 00 · Connectivity
item.description: Validate the key and see data coverage / data-quality counters.

item.name: Meta - key check, coverage, data quality

request.description:
Returns the calling client, the posted status ids, the date range covered by posted vouchers and data-quality counters:
- `unbalanced_vouchers` – posted vouchers whose lines do not net to zero
- `entries_with_unknown_account` – posted lines whose account no longer exists
- `lines_without_voucher_excluded` – orphan lines (always excluded)

Use as the first query in Power BI to fail fast on a bad key.
